scope: recheck and implementation checkpoint; open entries are not completion evidence; see RESULTS for executed commands

findings.title: Citation checking accepts opposite and insufficiently supported claims
findings.basis: Production negatives reproduced; literal/scope abstention, mapping/type-label guards, persisted revisions/support and deterministic derivations added. General semantic checker and complete writer remain open.

findings.title: Production candidate logic is restricted to fixture names
findings.basis: Removed named fixture catalogue regex from production candidate extractor. Three unseen-entity/unknown-evidence controls pass. Literal grammar remains bounded; structured model extraction remains open.

findings.title: Verify and related actions are mostly event labels
findings.basis: Executor still treats several verify/compare/calculate actions as events. Report derivation receipts do not complete those action handlers.

findings.title: Task coverage is inferred from source presence
findings.basis: toState still initializes coverage from source presence. Must replace with criterion-linked outcomes.

findings.title: Live synthesis remains a deterministic scenario composer
findings.basis: composeReport remains deterministic and partly templated. Unsupported sections now abstain; this is not general model synthesis.

findings.title: Fetched HTML is truncated and mislabeled as complete evidence
findings.basis: Controlled fetch uses sandboxed Trafilatura, saved bytes, structured blocks and partial coverage. Real-byte experiment recorded; challenge/MIME/coverage work remains.

findings.title: PDF attachment feature does not parse real PDF bytes
findings.basis: Legacy attachment API still accepts pasted text labelled PDF. New offline adapter honestly returns PDF unsupported; no binary upload completion claim.

findings.title: Correction reuse is a flag rather than demonstrated evidence reuse
findings.basis: Correction flags do not establish immutable evidence membership or actual reuse.

findings.title: Live spending admission is non-atomic and estimated cost is called confirmed
findings.basis: Atomic project reservation and logical provider attempt, unknown retention and actual usage.cost conversion added. Per-run/key scope and complete gateway accounting remain.

findings.title: Accepted run and queue admission have a crash gap
findings.basis: Local real PostgreSQL/pg-boss tests cover atomic admission/outbox and retry. External exactly-once delivery is not claimed.

findings.title: Leases and terminal mutations are not fully fenced
findings.basis: Unique attempt ownership, row-serialized acquisition, heartbeat and fenced worker writes added. Legacy recovery setup and complete evidence-basis checks remain.

findings.title: Network fetch protections are incomplete
findings.basis: Validated DNS pinned to socket, bounded streams/redirects/deadline, HTTP status retained. Local HTTP transport tested; private query policy still requires work.

findings.title: Deletion does not cover all private data paths
findings.basis: Deletion covers added extraction/support stores but legacy raw attachment files and derived stores still need complete purge.

findings.title: Production identity and cross-object ownership are incomplete
findings.basis: Admission rechecks attachment/parent/conversation ownership atomically. Production identity and other cross-object paths remain open.

findings.title: Model admission trusts an overly broad proposal shape
findings.basis: Run/revision match, post-transform admission and server tariff floor repaired. Executable action arguments remain overly broad.

findings.title: Benchmark measures fixture machinery rather than independent quality
findings.basis: Historical fixture benchmark is diagnostic only. Same-pipeline held-out general evaluation remains unimplemented.

findings.title: Mobile secret storage and in-flight account isolation need strengthening
findings.basis: Mobile token still uses AsyncStorage; request/account generations are not implemented.

findings.title: Shared Markdown loses usable evidence references
findings.basis: Markdown exporter still uses abbreviated passage IDs without a usable bibliography.

findings.title: Canonical documentation overstates or contradicts current state
findings.basis: Current status/handoff now distinguish historical evidence, failures and scope. Legacy review validator and broader canonical reconciliation remain open.
